provenance: Non-sensitive labels derived from frozen EgoPulse architecture and contract decisions through phase 2-13.

cases.query: Which component may commit accepted Memory truth?

records.content: The Rust Memory Authority is the single writer for accepted Memory state.
The Python Worker reads accepted Memory records from a bounded snapshot.
The Local API exposes governed Memory retrieval to authenticated clients.

cases.query: Can the cognition worker update a durable fact?

records.content: Python ranks supplied records but cannot create, modify, promote or revoke a Memory fact.
The Rust control plane records each durable Harness dispatch.
An agent may propose a candidate Memory record for later governance.

cases.query: Do CLI and TUI have different business capabilities?

records.content: CLI and TUI use one shared Rust kernel; only presentation and interaction sequencing differ.
Desktop delivery follows CLI and TUI in the planned product sequence.
The TUI renders terminal-oriented status and approval views.

cases.query: Who may promote an agent-written Memory candidate?

records.content: Only Founder governance may promote a candidate Memory record to accepted state.
An agent can write a candidate proposal but cannot accept its own Memory.
The retrieval Worker ranks accepted records without changing their state.

cases.query: What records are allowed to enter retrieval?

records.content: Retrieval receives accepted records from one exact governed scope snapshot.
Candidate records remain outside retrieval while they await Founder review.
Revoked records remain auditable but cannot participate in retrieval.

cases.query: Is a vector index the authoritative Memory database?

records.content: Vector indexes are rebuildable derived data and never the source of Memory truth.
SQLCipher persistence stores governed Memory Authority facts.
An embedding model converts query and record text into candidate vectors.

cases.query: Which Harness is admitted for production execution today?

records.content: Codex App Server is the only Harness currently admitted to the production composition.
Kimi remains a Harness candidate with an authentication-required probe result.
DSH remains a Harness candidate without native recovery proof.

cases.query: What evidence is missing before a second Harness can go live?

records.content: A second Harness needs authenticated lifecycle and native recovery evidence before production admission.
The provider-neutral contract can describe more than one Harness capability profile.
The Codex production runner already has a live governed work-loop proof.

cases.query: Python 认知 Worker 能直接写入或修改 Memory 吗？

records.content: Python 认知 Worker 只有只读检索权，不能创建、修改、晋升或撤销 Memory 事实。
Python Worker 对 Rust 提供的 Memory 快照执行候选排序。
Agent 可以提交候选 Memory，但候选尚未成为被接受的事实。

cases.query: CLI 和 TUI 是否拥有不同的内核业务能力？

records.content: CLI 与 TUI 共用同一个 Rust 内核，差异只在展示方式和交互顺序。
Desktop 在一期 CLI、TUI 能力完成后再进入交付。
TUI 使用终端组件展示任务、审批和执行状态。

cases.query: 检索结果会把原始记忆正文直接返回给调用端吗？

records.content: 检索 Worker 只返回 Memory 引用、来源引用、内容摘要值、分数和证据引用，不返回原始正文。
Rust Authority 向受监督 Worker 提供有界的原始 Memory 内容快照。
CLI 和 TUI 根据治理后的读取模型展示检索状态。

cases.query: Memory 检索会作为持久化后台任务保存吗？

records.content: 当前 Memory 检索在有界超时内同步执行，检索结果不会持久化为后台作业。
Harness 执行派发具有持久化 Attempt 和恢复语义。
Python 检索进程由 Rust 监督并限制帧大小和执行时间。

cases.query: 谁负责检索调用者权限与 scope 授权校验？

records.content: Daemon 根据已认证 principal 和治理策略执行 Memory 检索权限及 scope 授权。
Python Worker 校验输入记录与请求 scope 是否一致，但不拥有调用者授权。
CLI 与 TUI 通过本地认证会话调用 Local Cognition Service。

cases.query: Embedding 模型一旦选定就是不可替换的冻结架构吗？

records.content: Embedding 模型、维度和融合参数属于 Worker 边界后的可替换技术选择，不是 Memory 所有权架构。
Rust 单写者、治理状态与审计证据属于已经冻结的 Memory 架构边界。
向量索引只有在质量、延迟和生命周期证据充足后才可能进入技术选型。
